title: 星期五柠檬蛋糕  (Friday Lemon Cake)

segments.t: At nine thirty in the café corner, Mei pours fresh coffee for Teacher Song and Hao as they recall Friday afternoons twenty-five years ago. Listen first.
志豪，中午十二点你真的留在院子里迎志鹏吗？
留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
这么多年过去了，您还记得？
当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
宋老师，那怎么哄他开心呢？
他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
全都别动！现在几点？九点三十五分！
小美，千万别因为我们多忙活。
篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
'I am staying, Mei. Even if he turns around and walks straight out the gate.' Paired frame
就算
plus 'still/also' means 'even if'—even if he walks away, Hao stays.
志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
'Zhipeng will not leave. He always talked tough for five seconds, then softened right away.' Vivid character portrait:
嘴硬
literally 'mouth-hard', describes someone who talks tough while feeling soft inside.
当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
'Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.' Just like 'take-wrong' in Episode 1,
弹错
glues 'wrong' onto 'play' for hitting a wrong piano note.
宋老师，那怎么哄他开心呢？
'Teacher Song, how did you coax him into smiling again?' Warm family word
哄
means 'coax gently' or 'cheer up' someone who is sulking.
他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
'His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!' Thin coatings—dust, snow, powdered sugar, paint—use
一层
meaning 'one layer'.
啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
'Oh! Yellow lemon glaze—every single Friday the two of us fought over the corner piece!' Colloquial gem
俩
fuses 'two' and the general counter into a single syllable meaning 'the two of us'.
全都别动！现在几点？九点三十五分！
'Hold everything! What time is it right now? Nine thirty-five!' Playful freeze command:
全都别动
says 'everybody don't move!'—'hold everything!'.
小美，千万别因为我们多忙活。
'Mei, please do not go to extra trouble on our account.' Everyday spoken word
忙活
means 'busy oneself' or 'fuss around the kitchen'. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
志豪，中午十二点你真的留在院子里迎志鹏吗？
留下来，小美。就算他转身走出大门，我也认了。
志鹏不会走的。他总是嘴硬五秒钟，心马上就软了。
这么多年过去了，您还记得？
当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
宋老师，那怎么哄他开心呢？
他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
啊！黄色柠檬糖霜——每个星期五我们俩都抢边角那一块！
全都别动！现在几点？九点三十五分！
小美，千万别因为我们多忙活。
篮子里正躺着六个黄柠檬呢——厨房就等今天了！
多烤几块边角，好姑娘！
Six yellow lemons in the kitchen basket and two hours until noon—Mei is already tying on her apron. Let's step out into the courtyard next time. See you next time.
回头见！
